title: Sea of Stars: Sunset Edition coming to Switch 2 and PS5 in physical editions, 2 April 2027 (iam8bit)
label: رسمي

sources.name: iam8bit Sea of Stars pre-order page, read 17 Nov 2026: retail and iam8bit editions for PS5 and Switch 2, all dated 2 April 2027
Steam store page Sea of Stars: Sunset Edition (trailers)

footage: Official Steam trailers app 1244090 (Dawn of Equinox, Accolades), earlier footage said on screen; YouTube not used
gate: gate 20:30Z: iam8bit page read in full, two outlets agree; label رسمي

angle.hook: Sea of Stars gets its final physical release: Sunset Edition on Switch 2 and PS5 on 2 April 2027, with pre-orders open now.
angle.why_now: iam8bit and Sabotage opened pre-orders on 17 Nov 2026; Nintendo Everything 17:00Z, GoNintendo 19:14Z.
angle.what_it_means_here: Switch 2 players can pre-order a boxed copy with stickers and a soundtrack code; collector editions ship from iam8bit.
angle.limit: Retail street date and prices come from outlets, not the page; footage is the earlier Steam trailer.

spoken: Sea of Stars تصدر ورقيًا على Switch 2 بنسخة Sunset Edition يوم 2 أبريل 2027. ويفتح iam8bit الحجز المسبق للنسخ الخاصة على Switch 2 وPS5.
